path_rule: Each declared output path is relative to the supplied output root. The grader reads reference_dir / path and submission_dir / path. Directory argument names are opaque: do not append their basename or another outputs/ component unless it is part of the declared path.
control_evidence: submission_before and submission_sha256 keys are relative to the actual supplied submission root; use those records to establish placement.

trusted_inputs.usage: The grader may read original task inputs beneath the directory named by this environment variable. The controller supplies a separate immutable copy in factory controls and native Harbor verification and checks its original hashes before and after grading. Never use solver-workspace copies or hardcode a sandbox-specific input directory.
